# Task: Remove dead opengraph-image.png (shadow file blocks TSX generator)
## Description
<user_task_content>
## Overview
<recommendation_content>
## Problem

Both `src/app/opengraph-image.png` and `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx` exist in the same route segment. Next.js prioritizes the static `.png` file, so the `opengraph-image.tsx` dynamic generator is never invoked despite being built and tested in CI.

The TSX generator produces a branded 1200×630 OG image (dark gradient, Inter Bold font, 'My App' title) via `next/og`. The static PNG is a generic placeholder.

## Fix

Delete `src/app/opengraph-image.png`. This is the only change required — the TSX generator already has `export const dynamic = 'force-static'` for static-export compatibility, and `public/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf` is present.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `src/app/opengraph-image.png` no longer exists
- `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx` and `src/app/opengraph-image.test.ts` are untouched
- `npm run build` succeeds (the TSX generator produces the OG image at build time)
- The `<head>` of the built HTML includes `og:image` pointing to the generated image, not the removed static file
</recommendation_content>

## Context
- **Category:** bugfix
- **Priority Score:** 7/10
- **Estimated Complexity:** low

## Reasoning
<recommendation_content>
The static PNG silently overrides the styled TSX generator, meaning CI tests a code path that never runs in production. The TSX produces better output (branded, styled) and is already wired up correctly for static export. Removing the PNG is a single file deletion with no side effects.
</recommendation_content>
</user_task_content>
